issues.title: Extension Reader cannot validate and pin DNS resolution
acceptanceCriteria: Reader fetching remains distributed across clients
Literal private-address and redirect validation remain enforced
Residual public-hostname-to-private-address resolution risk is documented without claiming DNS pinning
issues.decision: Keep article pulls in the client extension to avoid centralizing publisher traffic and server load. Browser fetch does not expose or pin DNS answers, so the residual DNS-rebinding/public-to-private resolution risk is accepted as a platform constraint.
verification: bun run build-extension && bunx playwright test --config tests/browser/playwright.config.ts tests/browser/reader-extension.spec.ts (literal private targets and redirect validation passed)
